en.titre:
HOW TO BECOME
MORE ATTRACTIVE
AS A MAN.

en.texte: Look people in the eyes when you talk and when you listen. It shows confidence and real interest.
Rushed words sound nervous. Slow down, pause before you answer and let people wait for you.
A fit body shows in how you stand and move. A running coach app like Atala tells you what to run each day.
People notice your shoes. One clean pair of leather boots goes with almost everything you own.
Interesting people are attractive. A few pages every night gives you new things to talk about.
